import React from 'react'
import {Stack, Button} from 'react-bootstrap'

function Header() {
  return (
    <Stack direction="horizontal" gap={2}>
  <Button as="a" variant="primary">
    Button as link
  </Button>
  <Button as="a" variant="success">
    Button as link
  </Button>
</Stack>
  )
}

export default Header
